reading.body:
Cologix ASH2 sits on two adjacent addresses on Beaumeade Circle in Ashburn and publishes 51 MW of IT capacity. Among the 19 Virginia facilities on this site that publish a megawatt figure, ASH2 ranks ninth, accounting for roughly 3.8 percent of the 1,326 MW total published across the state. Virginia has 326 mapped facilities in aggregate, meaning the vast majority publish no capacity figure at all, so the state share above reflects only the fraction of operators who have disclosed numbers.

Fifty-one megawatts of IT load is a meaningful but not outsized block of power for AI work. As an assumption, at 40 kW per rack, a common density for GPU training clusters, 51 MW would support roughly 1,275 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation average, the same power supports around 5,100 racks. The arithmetic is 51,000 kW divided by the assumed rack draw. The operator does not publish a rack count, a density figure, or a tenant list, so which point on that range the campus actually operates at is not known from the published data.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no reading of what workloads they qualify the campus to host is possible from the data provided. What the published facts do establish is that ASH2 is a mid-tier campus by Virginia standards, located in the densest data center market in the United States, with enough raw power to matter to an AI buyer if the physical infrastructure supports the required rack density.
